name: – Nils Ušakovs – After § 24 – Am 13
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 24a. Rejects the EU taking over financing from other international entities, such as the US Agency for International Development (USAID); stresses, the importance of genuine independent investigative journalism free from EU subsidies, as independence is the true mark of a vivid democracy, transparency and social justice; points to the fact that the EU still has not come up with a clear definition of ‘misinformation’ and ‘fake news’;
